functions.recoveredRole: Opens the temperature step-list editor and accepts its count and numeric list on OK
functions.behavior: Constructs TParStepListEditor, passes the form's backing start temperature, end temperature, case count, and numeric list without first reading the visible edit controls, selects temperature mode, and shows the form modally. Modal result 1 writes the pre-dialog count to the Number of cases edit and then copies the editor output count and list reference to backing state. Other modal results copy nothing. The editor object is freed on every result path.
functions.evidence: The AnalModeDlg DFM binds btnListEdit.OnClick to 01155460. The handler constructs the class associated with the ParStepListEditor DFM, calls FUN_01437560 with form offsets 0xbe8, 0xbf0, 0xbe6, and 0xbf8, sets editor offset 0x71c to 1, and invokes ShowModal. Only result 1 calls FUN_00f04fa0 and FUN_01437590; FUN_00410f20 runs after the branch. ParStepListEditor.FormShow initializes its grid from the supplied list or start/midpoint/end defaults, OKBtnClick serializes the grid, and FormCloseQuery requires more than one row.
